name: Data Formats
tagline: CSV, JSON and XML in and out — the price list a supplier emails, the order feed a warehouse sends.
description: The files and feeds other systems send and expect — parse a CSV a supplier emails into records, write records back as CSV, parse and write JSON, read a value at a path inside JSON, parse an XML feed or invoice into an object — over papaparse and xml2js.
author: Etyma
